runs.name: The plan, 500 vehicles, one feeder
runs.note: The day-ahead plan told the price of energy, with in-order feeding, one long visit a day. Three days.

runs.name: A fixed threshold, 500 vehicles
runs.note: Called in at 20% charge, in-order feeding. The same days. Three days.

runs.name: A fixed threshold, emptiest vehicle fed first, 500 vehicles
runs.note: The power rule the project found to be the wrong one, at a size the feeder still carries. Three days.

runs.name: The plan, 1,000 vehicles, one feeder
runs.note: The site short of energy: the grid at its limit, vehicles waiting for a charger. At this size the low-battery floor, not the plan, calls most vehicles in. Three days.

runs.name: A fixed threshold, 1,000 vehicles
runs.note: The same days and size with no plan. Three days.
